title: mut.planes_not_points
mutation_directive: Replace point-sprite rendering with PLANE/SHEET rendering. Each particle becomes a small InstancedMesh of PlaneGeometry (or BufferGeometry of two triangles). Orientation strategy: pick (a) billboarded to camera (always-facing, gives bokeh-disk feel), (b) aligned to a local field normal (gives flake/foliage feel — each plane catches light differently), or (c) all parallel to a reference plane (gives stratified-layers feel). Per-instance color from the parent's palette logic. Per-instance opacity 0.04-0.12 so OVERLAP IS COMPOSITION — dense regions read as brighter saturated pools, sparse regions read as gauze. KEEP the parent's motion law unchanged; only the rendering primitive changes. The piece should now feel like accumulating washes of light, not falling dust.
